blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a structured grid layout, but the force-directed graph is too small to read node labels, the color-usage scatter is a wall of indistinguishable dots at this size, and there is no meaningful typographic hierarchy — competent but undesigned.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline correct, scaleSqrt used for both circle encodings (network nodes and color scatter), data-driven domains throughout (d3.max/d3.extent), calendar-aligned bins, fixed HCL axis bounds are semantically correct; minor: no key functions on bar joins but stable bin order makes this low-risk.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly coalesces all brush and click redraws; pointer events API prevents mouse-touch fights; no transitions means no mid-flight snaps; only minor stale-closure risk on brush x/y scales if the viewport were resized (no resize handler present).
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views are manageable and logically grouped, but the 60-node force network has overlapping labels at this viewport size and the color scatter renders as a dense noise field that requires hover interaction to extract any structure.
